name: @pipeworx/mcp-onet

tools.name: onet_search
tools.description: Search occupations by keyword. Returns matching O*NET occupations with SOC code, title, and relevance score. Example: onet_search({ keyword: "data scientist", _apiKey: "username:password" })

keyword.description: Search term — a job title, task, skill, or keyword, e.g. "nurse", "python developer"

_apiKey.description: O*NET credentials as "username:password" from a free O*NET Web Services account (services.onetcenter.org/developer/signup)

tools.name: onet_occupation
tools.description: Occupation detail for an O*NET-SOC code. Returns title, description, alternate names, and sample reported job titles. Example: onet_occupation({ code: "15-1252.00", _apiKey: "username:password" })

code.description: O*NET-SOC occupation code, e.g. "15-1252.00" (Software Developers). Get one from onet_search.

tools.name: onet_skills
tools.description: Skills for an occupation. Returns the ranked skill elements (name, description, importance score) for an O*NET-SOC code. Example: onet_skills({ code: "15-1252.00", _apiKey: "username:password" })

tools.name: onet_technology
tools.description: Tools & technology used in an occupation. Returns technology categories and example software/tools for an O*NET-SOC code. Example: onet_technology({ code: "15-1252.00", _apiKey: "username:password" })

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-onet forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the onet pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
